title: The Levers of Political Persuasion with Conversational AI
central_contribution: Complete original randomized human policy-attitude analysis across all three studies: base model versus control, dialogue/static and durability, all post-training and factorial contrasts, personalization, all prompt conditions, information-by-model interactions, deceptive prompt comparison, all corresponding original missing-outcome robustness, all original attrition analyses and original arm sample sizes.
primary_source_version: Final original public repository commit8c940f64fab49e9a071447237cd71b713b4e1de8 and original 5September2025 supplement; participant inputs unchanged since first4July2025 empirical data commit.

methods.individual_outcomes: Original released individual pre/post policy-attitude questionnaire values and original prepared aggregates. No published arm-summary table is used as an input.
methods.treatment_models: Reconstruct every original OLS design and source-defined reference group and filter independently from the archived scripts. Use original complete-case deletion for each formula, original imputed-with-pre robustness outcomes, original complete immediate/follow-up subset for durability, original unclustered stacked phase comparison for static/durability.
methods.standard_errors: Original estimatr lm_robust default unclustered HC2 sandwich; leverage correction e^2/(1-h), rank-aware OLS, n-rank Student t inference and95% intervals. Historical estimatr1.0.4 and current primary documentation agree. The authors' exact installed package version is not released.
methods.fixed_effect_syntheses: Original metafor method FE: precision weights1/SE^2, weighted mean, normal Wald inference. No random-effect or alternative estimator substitution.
methods.missingness: Original source post_missing != pre_missing and nonmissing grouping; original ANOVA lm(outcome_missing~factor) F-tests and group proportions; original descriptive sample-size filters.
methods.source_defined_control_duplication: Preserve original information-prompt subgroup code: controls present in the non-information subset are additionally appended, thus duplicated in that source-defined fit. Do not silently correct the author's design.
methods.rounding: Original source fun_round_fix_p rounds numerical fields to2 decimals, p-values to3 decimals with <.001 censoring; attrition proportions to3 decimals. Fixed gates use0.0051/0.00051; original integer df/counts exact.
methods.label_identity: Match every actual source-defined estimate by original table,row label and suffix; all missing or extra selected rows are reported.

omissions: Fresh model training/generation and new participant recruitment.

Separate Bayesian Student-t model-scale meta-regressions, GAM/LOO comparisons and census-weighted scaling-curve synthesis (TablesS8-S21,FigureS4); underlying original unweighted participant treatment estimates S6/S7 are included.
Model-derived claim extraction/factual accuracy and their statistical syntheses, including mainFigure4; original raw private chat logs are unavailable.
Bayesian latent claim-count/perceived-informativeness correlations and slopes (TablesS62-S69) and random-forest variance-explained analysis.
Human secondary perceived-informativeness outcome, demographics and conversation-length statistics; the complete selected primary policy-attitude outcome is retained.
Derived prose percentage improvements and digitization of plot curves; selected original statistical estimands are verified from all corresponding original printed treatment tables.
prospective_source_caveats: TableS22/S23 caption says collapsed across all study3 conditions, while its original analysis filters treatment-1 only; use and disclose the original code-defined estimator.
Durability tables use participants complete at both immediate and follow-up phases; stacked static comparison uses no participant clustering, as in the original source.
Selected information-by-model subgroup code duplicates non-information controls, as explicitly stated above.
MainFigure1 narrative/per-model post-training table and scaling-input tables use different source-defined regressions; retain both printed table families with their exact definitions.
Exact original estimatr/metafor version uncertainty is disclosed; no outcome-guided estimator selection is allowed.
success_rule: All2470 fixed gates must pass and independent audit must pass. No failed gate may be removed or loosened after outcomes. All failed runs and setup attempts retained.

eligibility.public_push_timestamp_uncertainty: Git commit/creation timestamps do not independently establish first public push; no earlier original empirical release of this paper was located. Both located original releases fall in the extended window.
